title: Predict Object Identity Behavior
description: Given a list `a = [1, 2, 3]` and `b = a`, predict `id(a) == id(b)` and the output of modifying `b[0] = 99`.
solutionCode:
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = a
print(a is b) # True
b[0] = 99
print(a) # [99, 2, 3]

title: Build a Simple Pointer Inspection Tool
description: Write a Python function using `ctypes` and `sys.getrefcount` to inspect the raw memory address and reference count of arbitrary objects.
solutionCode:
import sys, ctypes

def inspect_object(obj):
    addr = id(obj)
    refcnt = sys.getrefcount(obj) - 1
    print(f"Address: 0x{addr:x}, RefCount: {refcnt}")

title: Construct & Break a Reference Cycle
description: Create two instances of a Node class pointing to each other. Verify that reference count alone fails to free them, then solve the cycle using `weakref`.
solutionCode:
import weakref, gc

class Node:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
        self.peer = None

# Using weakref to break cycle
n1 = Node('A')
n2 = Node('B')
n1.peer = weakref.ref(n2)
n2.peer = weakref.ref(n1)
